segments.title: Cold Open: Mass Staff Layoffs & Fill-In Producer
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on; Case returns from illness to find half the staff 'sick' and missing; cousin Jace Lanfill pressed into service as fill-in producer.

segments.title: Trump–Zelensky Oval Office Confrontation Analysis
segments.notes: Case and Jace watch and dissect the 10-minute heated exchange between Trump, Vance, and Zelensky; Kendelle briefly interrupts with Blackpink ticket news.

segments.title: Fake Zelensky Call-In: 'Zalnova' Russian Impersonator
segments.notes: Jace dials a 'Zalnova' from a yellow pages; the Russian-accented guest refuses to opine on Ukraine, demands to play piano with his penis, and storms off.

segments.title: Transition to Amongst the Web & Doctor Tease
segments.notes: Case pivots to audience-submitted videos; mentions a 'BIN doctor on staff' for a later segment.

segments.title: Amongst the Web with Crum (Scrum)
segments.notes: Crum joins as 'Scrum' to rate viewer clips: ninja fear medallion, apple skepticism, semen retention club, pickle surprise, biblical recitation (1000 pts), cheating wife serial killer skit, and a dating-profile legal settlement.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Debate: Should We Yell at Foreign Leaders?
segments.notes: Munch argues for diplomatic respect; Crum takes the 'yell at allies' side for $5k gorilla debt leverage; debate ends tied; Rock-afire gorilla judges Crum unconvincing.

segments.title: Trailer Watch Party with Cousin Trent
segments.notes: Trent hosts horror-comedy 'The Parenting', Holocaust drama 'The World Will Tremble', and Tom Hardy's 'Cannibal Comedian'; Kendall appears, debates Hardy's nerd/jock placement.

segments.title: Dr. Brisket Debut: Hepatitis Outbreak & Needle Reuse
segments.notes: New network physician Dr. Brisket admits to reusing needles; Chef Stethoscope referenced; Case reminded to get foot inserts for upcoming trip.

segments.title: DJ Newsic Rapid-Fire News & Crum Apology Rap
segments.notes: DJ Newsic sings headlines: Madame Web Razzie sweep, Flashes app, James Cameron NZ citizenship, Epstein files redacted, Tate brothers banned from Florida, Twitch CEO 2025 plans; Crum whispers apology to cats while trash-talking gorilla at low volume.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors return from illness, manages skeleton crew, moderates Trump–Zelensky analysis and debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open sign-on; still jittery from Jolt Cola; runs around studio licking things.

characters.name: Jace Lanfill
characters.notes: fill-in producer. Case's cousin pressed into producer duty; operates switchboard, dials fake Zelensky, struggles with buttons.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appears as 'Scrum' for Amongst the Web, then debates Munch on yelling at foreign leaders while managing gorilla debt.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues for diplomatic respect in Munch & Crum debate; collects $5k after Crum deemed unconvincing by gorilla.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly interrupts news with Blackpink ticket win; later joins trailer watch party, questions Tom Hardy's nerd/jock alignment.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: guest host. Case's cousin(?) hosts trailer segment in fedora; introduces horror, Holocaust, and Tom Hardy films.

characters.name: Dr. Brisket
characters.notes: network physician. Debuts as BIN doctor; admits reusing needles; prescribes foot inserts for Case.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Delivers auto-tuned rapid-fire news from roof; manages lasers and apologetic trap beat for Crum.

characters.name: Rock-afire Gorilla
characters.notes: studio prop / creditor. Mechanical keyboard-playing gorilla; holds Crum's gambling debt; judges debate performance; paid today to avert violence.

storylines.beat: [01:14:34] Crum acknowledges ongoing debt arrangement with Rock-afire gorilla; [01:21:09] gorilla unpaid nearly a week; [01:27:32] gorilla paid today, violence deferred.

lore_notes.fact: Half the BIN staff is missing/sick; Case emailed 'the model' claiming Doge can't fire them because the network doesn't make money.
Jace Lanfill (Case's cousin) installed as fill-in producer on short notice.
Case and Kendelle secured Blackpink concert tickets after four people helped queue.
Crum owes gambling debt to Rock-afire gorilla; interest accrues weekly; gorilla judges debate performances.
Dr. Brisket introduced as network physician; admits to reusing needles; Chef Stethoscope confirmed as existing staff.
Crum scared studio cats with volume during debate; later delivers whispered apology rap at negative decibels.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from illness to a gutted newsroom, drafting cousin Jace Lanfill as producer while half the staff remains 'sick.' The broadcast dissects the Trump–Zelensky Oval Office shouting match, stages a prank call with a Russian 'Zalnova,' runs an Amongst the Web session with a combative Crum, and stages a Munch & Crum debate on diplomatic yelling that the Rock-afire gorilla judges in Munch's favor. The night closes with cousin Trent hosting a trailer watch party, the debut of needle-reusing network physician Dr. Brisket, and DJ Newsic's musical rapid-fire headlines before Crum whispers a cat apology while quietly insulting his gorilla creditor.
